title: Filing Complaints with the Central Authority

content.scenario: A group of consumers, affected by a company's unfair trade practices, want to file a complaint with the Central Authority. They identify the violation of consumer rights and prepare a complaint, along with safety notices and guidelines.
content.outcome: The Central Authority may inquire into the complaint, file a complaint before the relevant Commission, or intervene in any proceedings, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How to file a complaint with the Central Authority?
What is the role of the Central Authority in consumer protection?
Can the Central Authority intervene in proceedings?
